description: Read-only: inspect what a COMP exposes — its Python storage dict (keys + values), its extension class descriptors (name, promoted flag, public members), and its custom-parameter definitions (page/name/style/default). Closes the inspect side of the reusable-component loop: use after `scaffold_extension` + `add_custom_parameters` to verify what was built, or call standalone to examine any COMP without resorting to raw Python. Returns structured data for agent code-path consumption. API names vary by TD build; the `probe` field records which attributes were reachable.

include_storage.description: Include the COMP's Python storage dict (keys + JSON-able values).

name: inspect_op_extensions_storage

custom_pars.description: Custom-parameter definitions on the COMP, across all custom pages.

extensions.description: Extension class descriptors attached to the COMP.

members.description: Public (non-dunder) member names on the extension object (capped at 50).

name.description: Extension class name as registered on the COMP.

promoted.description: Whether the extension's members are promoted onto the COMP.

path.description: Full path of the inspected COMP.

probe.description: API-reachability map from the bridge — records which storage/extension/custom-par APIs were available on this TD build. UNVERIFIED: exact attribute names vary by build.

storage.description: Python storage dict — keys and their JSON-serializable values (non-serializable values are stringified).

warnings.description: Per-item problems that did not abort the inspection.

title: Inspect COMP extensions, storage, and custom parameters
